comment: Los Clásicos — the permanent hall of fame. These Valley institutions are honored here and do NOT compete in the weekly Power Rankings (they were moved out of watchlist.json on 2026-07-20 so the weekly list stays a race between current contenders instead of the biggest names coasting). Static content: no scoring, no API calls. Add a spot only when it's truly canon — decades of history or genuine Valley-wide beloved status.
section_note: The all-timers. These legends aren't ranked — they're the reason the Valley eats this well in the first place.
section_note_es: Los de siempre. Estas leyendas no se rankean — son la razón por la que el Valle come tan bien.

spots.name: Delia's Tamales
spots.known_for: 18 kinds of handmade tamales — famous statewide, but ours first
spots.known_for_es: 18 tipos de tamales hechos a mano — famosos en todo Texas, pero primero fueron nuestros

spots.name: Vera's Backyard Bar-B-Que
spots.known_for: The last true pit-smoked barbacoa de cabeza in Texas — a James Beard "America's Classic"
spots.known_for_es: La última barbacoa de cabeza en pozo de todo Texas — un "America's Classic" de la Fundación James Beard

spots.name: Taco Palenque
spots.known_for: The border's 24/7 taco institution — pirata tacos and salsa bar supremacy
spots.known_for_es: La institución taquera 24/7 de la frontera — tacos pirata y la mejor barra de salsas

spots.name: El Pato Mexican Food
spots.known_for: The homegrown patos chain — soft, griddled and open since the '70s
spots.known_for_es: La cadena de patos del Valle — suavecitos, doraditos y abiertos desde los 70s

spots.name: Los Compadres
spots.known_for: The legendary Mexican breakfast & lunch buffet — menudo, pozole, barbacoa, nopalitos
spots.known_for_es: El legendario buffet mexicano de desayuno y comida — menudo, pozole, barbacoa, nopalitos

spots.name: Casa De Mariscos
spots.known_for: Seafood botanas piled with fried shrimp, stuffed crab and oysters — a Weslaco landmark
spots.known_for_es: Botanas de mariscos con camarón frito, jaibas rellenas y ostiones — un símbolo de Weslaco
